content.title: Live Stream Script: Portable Power Station 600W (Demo Sample)

capabilities.text: Delivers **600W pure sine wave** AC output, suitable for small appliances and sensitive electronics.
Equipped with **LiFePO4 battery cells**, designed for a longer cycle life compared to standard ternary lithium batteries.
Supports **solar panel charging**, enabling power replenishment in outdoor or off-grid scenarios.
Features **multiple output interfaces** (AC/USB-C/USB-A/Car Port) to power several devices simultaneously.
Roadmap — planned, not available for demonstration or delivery. Localized manuals and after-sales support via local partners are in the planning stage.

timeline.title: Welcome & Disclaimer
talking_points: Introduce the product as a demo sample.
State clearly that this is a fictional demonstration.
timeline.spoken: Hello everyone, welcome to our live session. [pause] Today, we are showcasing the **DEMO-BRAND Portable Power Station 600W**. [pause] Please note, this is a **fictional demonstration sample** for illustrative purposes only. [pause] It is not a real customer sale or partnership announcement. [pause] Let's explore how this unit can support your outdoor and emergency power needs.
timeline.action: Host stands next to the product on a table, smiles, and gestures to the 'Demo Sample' label on the device.

timeline.title: Power Challenges in Daily Life
talking_points: Unstable power supply in some regions.
Need for power during camping or outdoor events.
timeline.spoken: Many of us face **unstable power supplies** or unexpected outages, especially during storm seasons. [pause] For outdoor enthusiasts, finding reliable power for laptops or lights can be challenging. [pause] Traditional power banks often lack the **AC output** needed for larger devices. [pause] This creates a gap for a versatile, portable solution.
timeline.action: Host holds up a standard small power bank, then sets it aside to contrast with the larger demo unit.

timeline.title: Introducing the 600W Solution
timeline.spoken: This unit offers a **600W pure sine wave** AC output, safe for sensitive electronics. [pause] It uses **LiFePO4 battery cells**, known for their stability and longer cycle life. [pause] You can recharge it via **solar panels**, making it ideal for sunny outdoor locations. [pause] With multiple ports including USB-C and AC, you can charge **multiple devices** at once.
timeline.action: Host points to the specification label on the side of the unit and traces the line from the battery icon to the output ports.

timeline.title: Live Demonstration of Implemented Features
talking_points: Demonstrate AC output with a small fan.
Show USB-C charging for a phone.
Explain solar input port (no solar panel connected).
timeline.spoken: Let's see it in action. [pause] I am plugging in this small fan to the **AC outlet**. [pause] As you can see, it runs smoothly thanks to the pure sine wave. [pause] Next, I connect my phone via **USB-C** for fast charging. [pause] Here is the solar input port; while we don't have a panel connected today, it supports solar recharging. [pause] Please remember, localized manuals and specific after-sales structures are **planned features**, not currently available for demonstration.
timeline.action: Host plugs in a small desk fan to show it running, then connects a smartphone via USB-C cable to show the charging indicator light.

timeline.title: Hypothetical Usage Scenarios
talking_points: Scenario 1: Camping trip with laptop and lights.
Scenario 2: Emergency backup for home router.
timeline.spoken: Imagine a **camping trip** where you need to power a laptop and LED lights. [pause] This unit can handle both simultaneously. [pause] Another scenario is using it as an **emergency backup** for your home router during a short outage. [pause] These are **hypothetical workflows** to illustrate potential utility, not records of real customer usage.
timeline.action: Host displays a printed card with icons representing a tent and a home router to visualize the scenarios.

timeline.title: Compliance & Important Notices
timeline.spoken: It is crucial to clarify our compliance stance. [pause] We do **not claim** any specific safety certifications like UL or CE for this demo sample. [pause] We have not fabricated specific cycle counts or charging times. [pause] Please listen carefully to this notice: **Fictional demonstration sample; not a real customer, sale or partnership.** [pause] Data sovereignty and market access details are **to be verified** and not promised here.
timeline.action: Host holds up a sign with the text 'DEMO ONLY - NO CERTIFICATION CLAIMS' and reads the notice clearly.

timeline.title: Q&A Session
talking_points: Address common objections: price, certification, support.
Refer to roadmap for planned features.
timeline.spoken: We have time for a few questions. [pause] If you ask about **price**, please note that no specific pricing is provided in this demo. [pause] Regarding **certification**, we do not claim any passed certifications for this sample. [pause] For **support** inquiries, remember that localized after-sales services are part of our **roadmap**, not currently implemented. [pause] We appreciate your understanding of these boundaries.
timeline.action: Host looks at a tablet screen simulating incoming questions and gestures openly to indicate transparency.

timeline.title: Closing & Next Steps
talking_points: Encourage following for updates on roadmap.
timeline.spoken: To summarize, this 600W station offers **versatile power** for outdoor and emergency use. [pause] Follow our channel for updates on **planned features** like localized support. [pause] Thank you for joining this **fictional demonstration**. [pause] Have a great day, and stay powered up!
timeline.action: Host waves goodbye, turns off the demo fan, and fades out the screen.
